custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create 201 parts for this test whose part numbers start with the same text, so one search lists all 201, and set all 201 inactive.
    • How to do it: Click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Inventory under IMPORTS in the left menu; click Download Template, open the file in a spreadsheet program, add 201 rows, one per part, with part_number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839418-001 to ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839418-201, name ZZAUTOTEST PL C839418 PART and the same number, quantity 1 and purchase_price 10, and save it as a CSV file. Click Select CSV File, pick the file, then click Submit File. Then, on the Inventory page, click the three-dot actions button, Deactivate parts, search ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839418-, tick the parts (200 at most per change, so do it in two goes), click Deactivate on the dark bar, then Deactivate in the confirmation.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Inactive tab.
